newsitem.title: USA: Police believe serial bomber at work in Atlanta.
newsitem.headline: Police believe serial bomber at work in Atlanta.

text.p: Federal agents investigating recent bombings against an abortion clinic and a gay club in Atlanta have concluded the attacks were done by the same person or persons, the Washington Post reported on Thursday.
The newspaper quoted law enforcement officials as saying that some evidence suggests the bombings may be connected to the 1996 Olympics bombing.
Sources familiar with the investigation said the agencies investigating the bombings, believe they are matching wits with a serial bomber, who they fear will strike again.
Senior investigators say weeks of intensive scientific analysis and investigative work led them to conclude the attacks on the clinic and gay club were the done by the same person or persons.
The design of the bombs was almost identical, and investigators matched key components and tool markings from bomb fragments at both sites.
Iron shrapnel was found at both sites, as well as Centennial Olympic Park, and it apparently came from the same smelter or foundry, the newspaper said.
The Olympic bombing killed one person and injured 111 others. The clinic and club bombings resulted in no deaths.
